facts.fact: Ethio Telecom, Djibouti Telecom and Sudatel turned a December 2024 cross-border fibre memorandum into a binding agreement for a terrestrial corridor from Djibouti's landing stations through Ethiopia to Sudan's landing stations; the document gives no signing day, so the published date is used.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel Group
systems.tiers: operators; hyperscalers and carriers as prospective customers
